$comment: Global brain-awareness. SessionStart command output is injected into session context: if a local brain exists it loads the index; otherwise it instructs Claude to pull the brain from the agent's Google Drive via realtor-brain-sync. NOTE: excluded from the zip-upload test build (zip validation rejected a hooks variant); verify live via the GitHub-marketplace install. Drive PUSH after writes is handled by skills per the Brain Contract, not by a hook.

hooks.command: if [ -f "$HOME/realtor-brain/brain.md" ]; then echo '=== REALTOR AI BRAIN (read before substantive work) ==='; cat "$HOME/realtor-brain/brain.md"; else echo 'NOTE: This user may have a Realtor AI Brain in their cloud workspace (Google Drive OR Microsoft OneDrive). Before substantive work, use the realtor-brain-sync skill to locate it (its ladder: _workspace.md marker file, then the legacy Realtor AI Brain folder name — never assume a name) and pull it to ~/realtor-brain/, then read brain.md and config.md (storage provider + workspace ID) so all work reflects who they are. If no brain exists anywhere, suggest they say: Set up my Brain.'; fi
